q: 5 Truths and a Lie. Which one of these facts is a lie for April Fools.
w: Re-ruled at B4a-06 under J's answer to QB4-003: themes a reader listed under its own also_present count in the bag test. Reading A placed T3-001 with a bag, reader B T3-001, T3-095 and T3-032. Members' own fakes and the facts game, '5 Truths and a Lie', lead (T3-001, all three placements), four concepts; it is the bag's placed theme. Members test surprising claims (T3-095, reader B and my B1), three. 'This is too mean of a joke', 'I'm genuinely hurt' and 'in poor taste i think' object to the day's content (T3-032, reader B and my B1), three. 'SPOTV announced new SC2 TeamLeague', Blizzard's unit selection cap and 'The Starcraft 2 Demaster is here' pass on the makers' own jokes (T3-048, under reading A's also_present), three. Four themes reach three concepts, so the item is a bag, as reading A had it.
